description: Create a whole custom bracelet bead set in one download. Enter up to 12 bead labels, choose cube, coin, or barrel beads, set the size and hole diameter, then pick raised or recessed lettering. Make personalized letter beads for friendship bracelets, craft projects, classroom name strings, zipper pulls, gift tags, and keychain accents. This parametric OpenSCAD generator creates a full batch of matching beads with adjustable size, thickness, stringing hole, and per-bead face lettering, so you can generate a complete name/word bracelet instead of downloading each letter as a separate file. Features: - Cube, coin, and barrel bead styles. - Adjustable bead size, thickness, bead count, and spacing. - Up to 12 separate label fields, one per bead. - Horizontal side-stringing hole by default for classic bracelet-bead layouts. - Optional vertical hole mode, offset below the letter, for name-string or tag layouts. - Raised or recessed label text. - Optional back-side label. - Rounded cube corners and optional barrel rib detail. - Cutaway preview mode for checking hole and label depth. The default prints a small `FRIEND` bracelet-bead set with horizontal side-stringing holes. The default 3 mm holes bridge cleanly on normal tuned printers, so it can print without supports while looking more like classic bracelet beads. For bracelet stringing, test your cord/elastic against `hole_diameter` ; different filaments and printers can make small holes tighter than expected. Safety note: these are small parts. Not for children under 3, and not for any use where broken or loose beads could become a choking hazard. Customization Notes - `bead_style` : choose cube, coin, or barrel. - `bead_count` : number of beads in the batch, up to 12. - `bead_size` / `bead_thickness` : bead face size and height. - `hole_diameter` : string/elastic hole size. Increase for fuzzy cord or printers that close small holes. - `hole_orientation` : horizontal is the default for classic side-stringing; vertical is available for top/bottom stringing or tag-style use. - `hole_y_offset` : moves the vertical hole away from the label when vertical mode is selected. - `label_1` through `label_12` : text for each bead. One letter per bead works best; short symbols or numbers also work. - `label_style` : raised lettering is easiest to see; recessed lettering gives a cleaner engraved look. - `show_back_label` : duplicates the label on the back face.

description: Badge reel to show your love of Silence of the Lambs or Buffalo Bill, or maybe it just looks cool. Looks super clean in person. It fits neatly with a readily available and inexpensive badge reel available on amazon or elsewhere (very inexpensive). Generic badge reel pictured is just over 32mm wide. I have found that a few 25mm circles cut out of paper towel or toilet paper help for strong adhesion to the reel. To assemble the reel cover, put a few drops of glue into the cavity where the reel will go. place a few layers of paper towel down and press them so the glue soaks through. Place a few more drops of glue in the center of the paper towel and press down the badge reel. I use more glue on this than I normally do on such a small model, but the paper helps to overcome the difference in the shape of the cavity and the reel itself creating a really solid finished product. In this example I use a small amount of Gold Leaf colored “Rub'n Buff” to highlight the details. a similar effect could be done dry brushing with acrylic paint or even a crayon followed by a little heat to set it in. I have taken this same model and given it a few coats thin of black primer before then applied the rub n buff followed by a coat of clear sealer and the effect is even better, but the pictured model is just the rub n buff.

description: 棘冕 Thorn Crown｜荆棘毒刺雕塑指环 荆棘代表磨砺，桂冠象征自我加冕，棘冕将荆棘王冠的厚重哲思凝为纯白雕塑，把苦难淬炼、自我成长的内核融进方寸指环，打破荆棘符号只代表伤痛的刻板印象，打造属于坚韧独立者的小众艺术配饰。 整件作品为一体亮面纯白材质，通体光滑细腻，完整复刻荆棘编织成环的形态。尖刺棱角分明却边缘圆润，荆棘枝蔓相互交错缠绕，构成完整环形冠身；枝杈交错间形成大量镂空空隙，让厚重荆棘结构变得轻盈通透。尖刺错落朝外排布，复刻自然荆棘野生锋芒，环形闭环代表圆满自洽，硬朗线条搭配纯白柔和底色，刚柔平衡，兼具野性力量与清冷高级质感。光线穿过镂空缝隙，在肌肤投射交错枝影，抬手之间，光影随角度变幻，让静态荆棘拥有丰富动态层次。 “棘冕”，棘是人生必经的荆棘磨难，冕是不靠他人馈赠、由自己挣来的王冠。荆棘自古是磨难、历练的符号，王冠代表荣耀与底气。棘冕想要传递：所有光鲜底气都源自一路荆棘打磨，不必等待外界认可，历经磨砺后的自我认可，才是最高贵的加冕。尖刺是保护自我边界的铠甲，交错枝蔓是层层成长沉淀，寓意接纳人生坎坷，把所有挫折化作支撑自己的底气。 冷感中性风格适配丰富穿搭，暗黑复古、哥特风、工装户外、极简清冷穿搭都能适配。日常通勤佩戴，纯白弱化荆棘的尖锐感，低调暗藏态度；写真拍摄、艺术沙龙、个性穿搭场景，荆棘王冠造型极具记忆点。材质一体成型稳固抗造，所有尖刺全部钝化打磨，兼顾雕塑锋利视觉与佩戴安全。可单独佩戴彰显坚韧气场，也能搭配流焰、深海系列戒指叠戴，硬朗荆棘搭配柔润曲线，塑造丰富穿搭情绪。 世人畏惧前路荆棘，却不知荆棘终会编织成专属王冠。棘冕以荆棘为环，以成长为冕，它提醒佩戴者，坎坷从不是阻碍，而是雕琢自我的刻刀。不必渴求他人加冕，踏过荆棘，熬过历练，你本身就拥有独属于自己的荣耀桂冠。 Thorn Crown – Thorn Laurel Sculpture Ring Thorns stand for hardships, and laurel crowns symbolize self-coronation. Thorn Crown condenses profound philosophy of tempering and growth into white sculpture, breaking the stereotype that thorns only signify pain. It is niche wearable art made for resilient, independent souls. Monolithically made of glossy smooth white material, the ring recreates a ring woven entirely from wild thorns. Sharp spikes have rounded polished edges; interlaced thorn branches twist into a complete circular crown. Countless hollow spaces between tangled twigs lighten the heavy structure of brambles. Light filters through hollow cutouts, casting branching shadows on skin; every hand movement reshapes light distribution, adding vivid dynamism to static thorn sculpture. The name Thorn Crown holds clear philosophy: “Thorn” refers to unavoidable life hardships, while “Crown” honors glory earned through your own efforts rather than external praise. Thorns have always represented trials, and crowns stand for confidence and honor. Thorn Crown conveys that all confidence comes from overcoming obstacles. You never need others’ approval; self-worth forged through struggle is the most precious coronation. Spikes act as armor guarding personal boundaries, and tangled branches symbolize accumulated growth, encouraging you to embrace setbacks and turn difficulties into inner strength. Its cool unisex aesthetic suits dark vintage, gothic, workwear, outdoor and minimalist styles. For daily commutes, plain white softens thorn sharpness for subtle attitude; for photoshoots and art salons, the thorn crown shape delivers unforgettable uniqueness. The solid integrated build offers sturdiness, with all spikes rounded to guarantee safe daily wear. Wear it alone to show resilient aura, or stack with Ember Drift and ocean-series rings, mixing tough thorns with gentle curves for layered emotional styling. Most people fear life’s thorns, unaware hardships weave your exclusive crown. Crafted from brambles and themed on growth, Thorn Crown reminds you obstacles refine character instead of holding you back. You need no outside validation; walking through thorns and overcoming trials lets you wear eternal self-made glory.

description: 优雅马蹄莲/花瓣美学戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 自然植物美学： 戒指正面以盛开的马蹄莲（或优雅花瓣）为灵感核心，层叠交错的花瓣自然包裹，线条优美流畅，散发着清新、高雅且浪漫的自然气息。 精致的同心圆层纹理： 如图中展示的那样，纯白色的花瓣表面与戒圈上呈现出极其细腻、宛如天然年轮或水波纹般的等高线层纹，为简约的花卉造型增添了独特的现代工艺质感。 一体化流线戒圈： 戒圈由花茎与花托部分自然向下延伸过渡，整体结构浑然天成，无需任何后期拼接，一次性3D打印成型。 纯净的微缩雕塑感： 采用纯白色的视觉呈现，既像一件精美的艺术微雕，又兼具现代极简主义首饰的高级时尚感。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常清新/法式穿搭配饰： 作为指尖的点睛之笔，完美适配法式优雅、森系清新或日常休闲的穿搭风格，低调中透着精致。 浪漫节日与纪念日礼物： 寓意纯洁与美好，非常适合作为情人节、生日或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的浪漫小礼物。 桌面艺术陈列： 不佩戴时，将其摆放在梳妆台或首饰架上，其优美的花朵造型本身就是一件极具观赏价值的桌面小品。 适配人群 自然与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱植物、花朵主题，钟情于温润柔和设计风格的首饰佩戴者。 极简美学饰品控： 喜欢线条流畅、造型不浮夸且带有独特3D打印肌理感的小众设计配饰达人。 3D 打印创客玩家： 喜欢打印精致微缩有机曲面、热衷于尝试不同纯色或丝绸质感耗材的DIY爱好者。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美呈现马蹄莲花瓣边缘的轻薄感以及表面细腻的同心圆层纹，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能让花瓣交叠处的弧度极其平滑，彻底消除阶梯感。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能有效保证戒圈及外翻花瓣的结构强度，防止日常佩戴时受力断裂。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的手感重量，并确保花瓣与戒圈连接处的绝对牢固。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s。慢速打印是保证花瓣边缘平整、表面纹理清晰均匀的关键。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，确保佩戴顺畅舒适。 桌面摆件收藏款（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸后可以作为精致的桌面花朵雕塑或小型戒指展示座。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或象牙白 PLA 耗材，呈现出类似高级陶瓷或石膏雕塑的纯净质感。 浪漫彩金/珍珠风： 推荐使用丝绸白金（Silk White/Pearl）耗材，打印出的花瓣自带珍珠般的柔和光泽，极其惊艳。 佩戴舒适度优化： 打印完成后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈稍微打磨光滑，确保贴合皮肤时温润舒适、不刮手。

description: 猫妖鳞片面具（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 奇幻生物美学： 巧妙融合了猫科动物的灵动耳廓与东方龙/奇幻野兽的鳞片元素，整体呈现出一种神秘、野性且优雅的妖精面具造型，极具视觉张力。 层叠复杂的鳞片肌理： 面具表面由成百上千片细腻的仿生鱼鳞/龙鳞紧密交织而成，从眉心向两侧呈放射状铺开，层次分明，立体感极强。 锐利夸张的边缘剪影： 耳朵外缘与面具轮廓带有大量尖锐、带有朋克风格的刺状装饰，配合明艳的红色，散发出浓郁的暗黑奇幻与魔幻现实主义色彩。 流线贴合的面部弧度： 整体呈现自然的内凹弧面，完美契合人脸轮廓，眼部开孔宽敞，兼顾了造型的艺术感与实际佩戴的视野。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 化装舞会与万圣节派对： 作为惊艳全场的独立面部饰品，完美融入哥特风、精灵风、赛博巫术或奇幻角色扮演（Cosplay）的装扮中。 主题摄影与潮玩陈列： 不仅能佩戴，其极具雕塑感的造型也非常适合作为摄影道具，或挂在墙面上作为独特的现代艺术墙饰。 个性化节日伴手礼： 送给喜欢奇幻文学、桌游跑团或动漫展爱好者的绝佳硬核礼物。 适配人群 Cosplay 与奇幻爱好者： 钟情于魔幻、精灵、龙族等神秘生物设定，热衷于打造独特个性造型的玩家。 暗黑美学与先锋时尚达人： 偏爱夸张、张扬、具有强烈视觉符号感配饰的潮流人士。 3D 打印造型发烧友： 喜欢高难度复杂曲面打印、享受大体积精细模型制作挑战的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美还原成百上千片细密鳞片与边缘利刺的锐利度，建议参考以下极限精度切片参数（ 注：由于面具属于大面积贴脸薄壁结构，强烈建议适当调慢速度 ）： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.12mm - 0.16mm。兼顾打印效率与鳞片表面的细腻层纹表现。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能彻底保证密集的鳞片结构与边缘尖刺坚固不易折断。 填充率（Infill）： 15% - 20%（推荐使用 网格 Grid 或 陀螺仪 Gyroid 填充），既能保持面具整体的轻量化（佩戴不压鼻梁），又能提供足够的结构强度。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）必须严格降速至 30-40 mm/s。由于面具表面有大量向外延伸的鳞片和倒刺，慢速能有效防止冷却不足导致的拉丝和变形。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 真人佩戴款（150-180mm 宽度）： 打印前建议使用卡尺测量自己双颊之间的最大宽度，在切片软件中对 X/Y 轴进行等比例微调，确保眼孔位置与自己的瞳距相匹配。 微缩收藏/摆件款（80-100mm）： 缩小尺寸后可搭配支架摆在桌面上作为精致的工艺品。 耗材与色彩推荐： 烈焰妖精风（如图中效果）： 使用 亮红色（Red） 、 金属赤红 或 熔岩橙 PLA 耗材，能瞬间突显出野兽与妖精的张扬与热烈。 暗夜精灵风： 使用 哑光黑 、 深紫色 或 丝绸暗金 ，后期可以通过局部干扫银色或金色颜料，让鳞片的层次感瞬间爆发，呈现出类似中世纪魔器的高级质感。 佩戴固定小贴士： 面具两侧边缘通常预留有穿线孔或微小凹槽，建议使用黑色松紧带或皮革绳穿过两侧固定；若需要直接贴脸，也可以在面具内侧贴上一层薄海绵条或防滑硅胶垫，能大幅提升长时间佩戴的舒适度。

description: 烬流 Ember Drift｜流焰火焰雕塑指环 当火焰挣脱炽热的色彩束缚，化作清冷纯白的指尖雕塑，烬流将火焰灵动翻涌的姿态永久定格，跳脱传统首饰柔美范式，以流动美学打造兼具热烈与静谧的先锋配饰，适配偏爱抽象艺术、流动氛围感穿搭的佩戴者。 戒指采用一体成型亮面纯白材质，釉面温润光洁，完整复刻火焰升腾翻卷的自然形态。整枚戒环由多片流线焰瓣环绕拼接而成，焰尖上扬舒展，焰身弯曲回旋，错落排布形成连绵起伏的环形轮廓；多处自然镂空穿插于焰纹之间，虚实交织，消解环形配饰的沉闷厚重。流畅曲面经过精细打磨，无生硬棱角，光影在光滑弧面不断流转，转动戒指时，明暗随焰形起伏变化，如同跳动的白焰在指尖缓缓流动，把瞬息万变的火焰定格为可长久佩戴的固态艺术。 “烬流” 二字暗藏双重意境，烬代表火焰燃尽后的沉静，褪去烈焰的躁动喧嚣；流指代火焰永不停歇的流动线条。火焰向来象征热忱、生命力、冲破桎梏的勇气，而纯白弱化火焰的攻击性，赋予温柔内核，寓意人生可以怀揣滚烫初心，却始终保有从容淡定的心境。不必外放张扬锋芒，内在生命力自有流动的力量，热烈与沉静本可共生。 中性无性别设计兼容多元穿搭，极简黑白通勤穿搭中，它是灵动的视觉亮点；赛博、暗黑、新中式、艺术风穿搭可完美适配；海边出行、艺术展览、小众聚会佩戴，流动焰纹辨识度拉满，告别大众配饰撞款。一体成型无拼接工艺坚固耐用，光滑边缘保障日常佩戴舒适，不会剐蹭肌肤。既可单戴凸显流动高级感，也能搭配羽翼、王冠系列指环叠戴，冷暖线条碰撞，丰富整套配饰层次。 世俗总认为火焰注定热烈张扬，烬流重新诠释火焰美学：热烈藏于肌理，温柔流于线条。以白焰为形，以从容为魂，指尖流转不息的焰纹，是藏在冷静外表下永不熄灭的生命力，任凭外界喧嚣，内心始终有自在奔涌的滚烫热忱。 Ember Drift – Flowing Flame White Sculpture Ring Breaking free from fiery bold hues, Ember Drift freezes dancing flames into cool white wearable sculpture. Departing from conventional soft jewellery aesthetics, it blends dynamic fluidity with avant-garde design for lovers of abstract art and flowing atmospheric styling. Crafted as a seamless glossy white sculpture with sleek glazed texture, the ring faithfully reproduces curling, rising fire shapes. The circular band is wrapped by sequential streamlined flame petals; flame tips stretch upward while bodies swirl and curve, forming an undulating ring outline. Natural hollow gaps scatter between flame patterns, weaving solid and void to banish the dull heaviness of closed bands. All curved surfaces are meticulously polished with no harsh corners. Light glides along glossy curves, creating shifting shadows as you twist your finger, just like pale fire flickering steadily on skin, freezing fleeting flame movement into permanent wearable art. Ember Drift carries layered meaning. “Ember” stands for quiet calm after burning out noisy fire; “Drift” refers to fire’s endless flowing lines. Fire has long symbolizes passion, vitality and courage to break limits. Plain white tones tone down aggression, adding tender connotations, meaning you may hold burning dreams yet stay calm and collected. True vitality needs no loud display; inner passion flows steadily beneath composed appearances. The unisex design matches all styling systems. It delivers subtle liveliness to minimalist monochrome office fits; it complements cyber, dark, neo-Chinese and artistic outfits perfectly. At seaside trips, art shows and niche social events, its unique flame silhouette stands out easily from generic accessories. The one-piece seamless build promises durability, with smooth edges preventing skin abrasion for daily comfort. Wear alone to highlight fluid luxury, or stack with wing and crown rings for contrasting line textures and richer accessory depth. Most people equate fire with loud recklessness, yet Ember Drift redefines flame beauty: passion lies within texture, gentleness exists within flowing lines. Shaped like pale flames and rooted in composure, the swirling fire on your fingertip represents perpetual vitality hidden under calm. No matter how chaotic the outside world grows, your inner passion keeps flowing freely.

description: 猫咪开口戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 猫咪轮廓首尾相呼应： 采用灵动的开口戒指结构，将猫咪坐立的背影剪影与卷曲的小尾巴巧妙地设置在开口两侧。佩戴时仿佛一只小猫温柔地环抱着你的手指，极具治愈感与趣味性。 极简几何剪影美学： 去掉了繁琐的面部与毛发纹理，仅保留小猫标志性的尖耳朵、圆润的身体弧度以及俏皮卷曲的尾巴尖。抽象的几何线条勾勒出高级的现代设计感，简约而不单调。 同心圆年轮纹理： 如图中所示，猫咪正面的微弧曲面完美契合了 3D 打印特有的“同心圆”等高线层纹。这些层纹如同树木年轮或指纹般自然延伸，为平整的金属感饰品增添了独特的艺术肌理。 贴合舒适的开口结构： 戒圈采用平滑加厚设计，内侧打磨平整，开口处预留了自然的过度空间，具有一定的微调延展性，大幅降低了圈号选错的风险。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常百搭萌系配饰： 时尚吸睛又不夸张，完美适配日系甜美风、极简通勤风以及日常休闲穿搭，是工位上极佳的治愈小单品。 猫奴/铲屎官专属标志： 作为爱猫人士的“身份认同”饰品，非常适合作为情侣款、闺蜜戒指或赠送给养猫朋友的趣味礼物。 桌面解压小软装： 取下摆放在键盘旁或办公桌上，其立体的猫咪背影本身就是一件极具温度的微缩极简雕塑。 适配人群 资深猫奴/宠物爱好者： 对猫咪元素毫无抵抗力，喜欢将萌宠元素融入生活细节的铲屎官们。 小众极简饰品收集者： 偏爱造型别致、线条流畅、具有几何现代感与艺术肌理首饰的潮流人士。 FDM 打印创客玩家： 喜欢挑战精致微缩小模型，享受随时随地根据手指尺寸“量体裁衣”定制打印的 DIY 达人。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保猫咪 ears（耳朵）与尾巴尖端的细节锐利，同时呈现出图中那种精致的同心圆表面肌理，建议参考以下切片设置： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议使用 0.08mm - 0.12mm（较低的层高能让猫咪背部的同心圆纹理过渡得极其平滑，同时确保猫耳和尾巴尖不糊）。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层（保证戒圈有足够的壁厚去承受微小的开口形变，避免佩戴时断裂）。 填充率（Infill）： 作为日常佩戴的戒指，建议设置为 100%（实心打印），这不仅能大幅提升戒圈强度，还能赋予其如同真正金属首饰般的沉甸分量感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）请务必降速至 25-35 mm/s，慢速打印是确保同心圆层纹清晰无瑕疵、猫耳尖端不拉丝的关键。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与圈号参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（尺寸缩放参考常规戒指内径 18–22mm）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使模型内圈直径（X/Y 轴内径）比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm。虽然是开口戒指，但预留少许公差能大幅提升佩戴舒适度。 桌面萌宠雕像（50–80mm）： 放大至手心大小，猫咪的背影和卷尾巴结构在放大后会呈现出极强的治愈系雕塑质感。 耗材与色彩推荐： 丝绸/蚕丝金属色（如图中效果）： 使用 蚕丝银（Silk Silver） 、 蚕丝白金 或 枪灰色 耗材，能打印出类似氧化哑光银首饰的高级金属光泽，极大提升质感。 哑光陶瓷色： 使用 哑光白（Matte White） 、 象牙黄 或 哑光黑 ，能消除塑料光泽，呈现出如白瓷或黑曜石般的抽象艺术感。 韧性强化提示： 虽然该戒指开口较宽，但如果需要微调圈号，建议使用 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 或 PETG 耗材打印，这能防止在手动撑开或捏紧戒圈时发生脆性断裂。 边缘倒角与打磨： 打印完成后，建议用 1000 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与开口处（特别是尾巴尖与猫耳朵边缘）轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时不卡手、不刮皮肤。

Bring your favorite football memes to life on your wardrobe! This unique DIY project features the iconic silhouette of Erling Haaland, 3D printed with an ultra-thin thickness of 0.4 mm . How It's Made (PLA+ Method): For this specific shirt, PLA+ was used. Since this filament is tougher to melt, it requires a specific technique combining high heat and immediate pressure: Setup: Lay the t-shirt perfectly flat on a smooth, heat-resistant surface (like floor tiles). Placement: Position the main Haaland design, then carefully place the 2 or 3 small detached pieces that aren't connected to the rest. Protection: Cover the entire design with tightly stretched baking paper. Heating: Use a heat gun to melt the filament onto the fabric through the baking paper. Pressing (The key step): Immediately after heating, firmly press a wooden cutting board directly onto the hot baking paper to force the melted filament into the fabric mesh for a solid bond. ⚠️ Warning: Do not stay in one spot for too long with the heat gun! Heat evenly and keep moving, then press immediately to avoid deforming the plastic. 💡 Pro Tip: Which filament should you use? Standard PLA with a household iron (Possible, but not recommended): You can technically try using regular PLA with a standard iron (no steam) and baking paper, but the result isn't great. The plastic doesn't bond well to the fabric and tends to peel off easily. TPU Filament (The absolute best option): For the best results, we highly recommend using TPU (flexible filament) instead. It works beautifully with a regular household iron (no steam) . When heated, the TPU melts right into the fabric mesh, blending with the textile. This gives you maximum flexibility, a softer feel, and incredible longevity. 🧼 Care Instructions: To ensure your design lasts as long as possible, always wash the t-shirt at a low temperature and inside out .

This project is a premium parametric Cotton Pad Dispenser (Porta Algodão Dispensador) with a vertical U-shaped front slot. It allows you to load a stack of circular cotton pads from the top and easily pull pads out one-by-one from the bottom. Fully parametric in OpenSCAD, it features three standard capacities, optional screw-on lid configuration, and deep aesthetic customization. --- UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION --- With over 30 texture patterns and adjustable scales, this project offers hundreds of unique combinations for you to create an exclusive dispenser. --- PARAMETER GUIDE --- 1. Size & Capacity - Size Selection: Choose between three height capacities: - Small (P): Height 80mm (Holds approx. 20 cotton pads) - Medium (M): Height 120mm (Holds approx. 35 cotton pads) - Large (G): Height 160mm (Holds approx. 50 cotton pads) - Has_Lid: Option to include a screw-on lid. - Enabled (Yes): Adds a top thread to the base and exports the lid. - Disabled (No): Removes threads entirely, leaving a clean open-top dispenser with a smooth, rounded upper rim. 2. Dispenser Slot Settings - Cutout Width: Controls the width of the vertical dispensing slot (Default: 35mm). It is optimized to be wide enough for your fingers to easily pull a pad out, but narrow enough to keep the pads stacked securely inside. - Bottom Lip: Height of the bottom retaining wall that supports the stack (Default: 8mm). 3. Aesthetics and Texture - Surface Pattern: Applies geometric textures in high/low relief to the outer face (Default: Grid Diagonal). - Pattern Depth: Controls how pronounced the texture is (recommended: 0.6mm). - Pattern Scale: Adjusts the size of the texture tiles. Small variations in this scale dramatically transform the visual effect, essentially creating entirely new textures from a single base pattern. You can fine-tune the look from bold geometric shapes to fine, intricate details. Scale effects on the same pattern - Text Bands: Show customized text at the top (Default: "COTTON"). - Logo Patch: Creates a smooth, centralized area on the base for logos or custom labeling. --- TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & PRINTING --- - Support-Free Design: Both the dispenser base and the lid print completely without supports. The bottom of the U-slot is a semi-circle that prints cleanly in mid-air, and the inside has straight 62.0mm cylinder walls to prevent soft cotton pads from catching or tearing. - Smart Lidless Finishes: When printing without a lid, the top edge of the dispenser is automatically detailed with a smooth, 1.0mm double-rounded rim (both inner and outer lips). This ensures that cotton pads don't snag when loading and the top is completely safe and pleasant to touch. - Perfect Thread Synchronization: When the lid is enabled, the metric threading system includes a hardcoded thread phase (angular offset). This guarantees that when you fully tighten the lid, the texture patterns on the lid and the base align flawlessly, even with the vertical slot cutout. --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- - Layer Height: 0.16mm (Optimal) - Wall Generator: Arachne (Required for sharp texture details) - Line Width: 0.6mm (Outer & Inner walls) - Infill: 10 Gyroid or Cross Hatch - Speed: 100 mm/s (Outer & Inner walls for premium finish) - Supports: No supports needed! description: 骸蔓・圣柩（Skull Vine・Sacred Coffin） 骸蔓・圣柩白瓷戒指，融合欧式复古巴洛克雕花、哥特骷髅美学与东方德化瓷雕非遗工艺，打造华贵冷艳兼具的高端艺术指环，将古典宫廷繁复美学与生死意象巧妙相融，适配追求复古小众轻奢的佩戴人群。戒指以立体写实骷髅为视觉重心，颅骨雕刻细腻饱满，骨骼肌理、牙齿排布精准考究，肃穆沉静的骷髅自带古典宗教氛围感。环绕骷髅周身的是层层繁复的欧式卷草藤蔓雕花，花叶卷曲婉转、脉络深浅分明，藤蔓环环交织，向上汇聚成尖顶花苞造型，复刻中世纪欧式教堂浮雕纹样，繁复却排布有序，依托国画留白思路把控疏密，雕花饱满却不显拥挤，镂空区域恰到好处，兼顾华丽度与通透轻盈感。 甄选传世德化象牙白瓷打造，经过三遍施釉、两次高温煅烧，瓷色暖润如玉，白调温润柔和，冷白不发灰、死白不刺眼。釉面细腻油润，暗光下内敛高级，亮光下通透莹亮，把瓷材质感拉满。戒圈做分层雕刻，外圈布满细碎缠枝暗纹，内圈平滑圆润，佩戴兼顾华丽颜值与舒适体验，所有雕花凸起边缘全部做圆角打磨，杜绝勾挂衣物、划伤肌肤，日常佩戴安心无负担。 设计灵感源自中世纪墓园浮雕与哥特教堂石刻，骷髅代表永恒生命思考，缠绕藤蔓象征生死轮回、繁花伴枯骨，寓意繁华终归于沉静，于喧嚣中守住本心。风格华贵暗黑，适配复古礼服、巴洛克洋装、新中式国风穿搭、轻奢西装，女性佩戴华丽冷艳，男性佩戴贵气冷峻，适配晚宴、日常通勤、潮酷出行多场景。市面复古银饰雕花易氧化磨损，这款白瓷理化性质稳定，不怕汗水侵蚀、日常磕碰，久戴依旧光洁如新。所有藤蔓花叶均为手工逐层雕刻，雕花走向无重复模板，每一枚都具备独一性，收藏价值远超量产首饰。没有多余宝石堆砌，依靠瓷雕工艺撑起全部高级质感，将西方古典浮雕艺术落地于东方白瓷之上，中西美学碰撞独一无二。它跳出普通骷髅配饰的街头廉价感，自带宫廷华贵气场，温柔瓷白柔化骷髅的凌厉锋芒，华丽克制，高级耐品，是可日常佩戴、可收藏珍藏的跨界工艺珠宝。 Skull Vine · Sacred Coffin combines European Baroque carving, gothic skull aesthetics and intangible heritage Dehua porcelain carving craft, presenting luxurious, elegant yet cold high-end ring. It fuses classical court aesthetics with life-and-death imagery for niche retro luxury lovers. A realistic carved skull serves as focal point, with delicate bone texture and neat teeth delivering solemn medieval religious vibes. Intricate European scroll vines twist all around the skull, with curved leaves and clear veins converging into a bud top. Inspired by medieval church reliefs, dense carvings follow Chinese blank composition rules, rich yet orderly. Proper hollowing balances grandeur and lightness. Crafted with time-honored Dehua ivory white porcelain with triple glazing and double high-temperature firing, the porcelain boasts warm jade-like creamy tone, soft and mild without harsh grey or stark whiteness. The glossy glaze appears subtle in dim light and translucent under bright light, fully highlighting premium porcelain texture. The band features layered carving: outer surface covered with tiny twig patterns while inner wall stays smooth. All raised carving edges are rounded to prevent snags and scratches for safe daily wear. Drawing inspiration from medieval cemetery reliefs and gothic church stonework, the skull embodies meditation on eternal life, while winding vines symbolize samsara of life and death. It conveys that prosperity eventually calms down, reminding people to retain inner peace amid hustle. With luxurious gothic charm, it pairs well with retro gowns, Baroque dresses, neo-Chinese costumes and luxury suits, presenting glamorous coolness on women and noble sternness on men, fit for banquets, office and street fashion. Unlike easily oxidized vintage silver jewelry, stable porcelain resists sweat and abrasion, maintaining long-term glossiness. All vines and leaves are hand-carved with zero repeated patterns, endowing each ring high collectibility. It requires no gem embellishment, relying entirely on carving craftsmanship for luxury. Integrating Western classical relief with oriental porcelain, it delivers one-of-a-kind Sino-Western aesthetic collision. Escaping cheap street-style skull design, it carries courtly aura. Mild porcelain softens skull sharpness, gorgeous and restrained. It functions both as wearable daily jewelry and collectible cross-craft art piece.

description: Choco Snap – Clicky Chocolate Fidget Keychain A satisfying chocolate-shaped fidget keychain you can print in about an hour. 🍫 Choco Snap is a compact clicky fidget designed around three things: quick printing, low filament usage, and a satisfying mechanical snap. The three chocolate sections move independently, while a piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade creates the characteristic clicky action. Add a ball chain and Choco Snap becomes a compact fidget keychain you can carry on your bag, pouch, backpack, or keys. 🎥 Assembly Guide Please watch the assembly guide before preparing the steel tape measure piece or assembling the model. The video shows the complete assembly process, including the placement and orientation of the internal components. Watch the Choco Snap Assembly Guide ✨ Features 🍫 Chocolate-inspired design 🖱️ Satisfying mechanical click and snap ⏱️ Around 1 hour print time 🧵 Low filament usage 🔑 Compact keychain size 🛠️ Simple assembly 🎨 Easy to customize with different colors ♻️ Uses small pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins 🖨️ Printing Choco Snap was designed to be a quick and lightweight project that doesn't require a large amount of filament. PLA works well for the printed body. Because the model is small, it's a great project when you want something fun and functional without waiting several hours for a print. Actual print time and filament usage may vary depending on: Printer Print profile Layer height Print speed Filament Other slicer settings With an appropriate profile, the complete set of printed parts can be produced in approximately 1 hour . 🔧 Additional Parts Needed In addition to the printed parts, you will need: A piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade 1.75 mm filament for the hinge pins A ball chain or another keychain attachment, if desired The steel tape measure piece is a key part of the clicking mechanism and is required for the intended snap action. ⚙️ Important – Click Mechanism The key component of Choco Snap is the steel tape measure piece installed inside the model. Cut a piece from a steel retractable tape measure blade to approximately: 50 mm long × 10–11 mm wide The natural curved shape and elasticity of the steel tape are used to create Choco Snap's characteristic snap movement and clicky feel when the chocolate sections are pressed. After cutting the tape to size, install it inside the printed parts as shown in the assembly guide. The position and orientation of the steel tape piece are important for proper operation. If the click doesn't feel right after assembly, check the placement and orientation of the steel tape first. ⚠️ Cutting the Steel Tape Measure Please take care when preparing the steel tape measure piece. The cut edges of a tape measure blade can be sharp. When cutting it: Use appropriate cutting tools Wear eye protection Keep your hands away from the cutting area Smooth or deburr sharp edges before assembly Do not install the piece while sharp burrs remain on the cut edges. 🔩 Hinge Assembly The three chocolate sections are connected using short pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Cut the filament to the required length and insert it through the hinge holes to connect the sections. Using filament as the hinge pins keeps the assembly simple and eliminates the need for additional metal pins or screws. Basic Assembly Prepare the three printed chocolate sections. Connect the sections using 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Install the prepared steel tape measure piece. Check that each section moves smoothly. Test the snapping action. Attach a ball chain if you want to use Choco Snap as a keychain. For the exact assembly method, refer to the video at the top of this page. 🍫 Color Ideas Try printing Choco Snap in different “flavors”: Milk Chocolate Brown White Chocolate Matcha Green Strawberry Pink Dark Chocolate Caramel Or create your own flavor! Different filament colors can completely change the look of the model. If you print one, I'd love to see your color combination! 📌 Notes This model is a fidget/keychain and is not food . The click feel and sound may vary slightly depending on the filament, print tolerances, and steel tape measure piece. Make sure all sharp metal edges are properly smoothed before use. Actual print time may vary depending on your printer and print profile.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 三叶花瓣戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 高雅自然的植物姿态： 戒指正面以三片舒展的鸢尾（或百合类）花瓣为设计核心，花瓣呈品字形向外绽放，微翘的边缘与凹陷的瓣心构筑出立体的有机曲面，极具优雅与浪漫氛围。 细腻指纹般的叶脉纹理： 如图中所示，花瓣内部与戒圈表面布满了顺着曲面起伏延伸的同心圆与等高线纹理，宛如天然植物的叶脉肌理，将现代 3D 打印的层纹之美展现得淋漓尽致。 极简流线一体化戒圈： 戒圈由下方自然向上分叉过渡为支撑花瓣的花茎，整体线条纤细优雅，一次性 3D 打印成型，结构轻巧且贴合手形。 魅惑高贵的紫色视觉： 采用了极具神秘感的哑光深紫色呈现，既带着轻奢复古的艺术气质，又能作为指尖最吸睛的色彩点缀。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常精致/法式复古穿搭： 作为指尖的轻奢亮眼单品，完美适配法式优雅、小众设计师风、文艺优雅或早春浪漫系穿搭。 节日浪漫与闺蜜心意礼品： 鸢尾花象征着爱意、光明与优雅，非常适合作为生日、情人节或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的暖心好礼。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于妆台或陈列盘中，优美的花朵造型宛如一座精致的极简植物雕塑。 适配人群 植物美学与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱自然花草主题、钟情于线条柔美且富有灵动感配饰的时尚爱好者。 紫色与小众设计师饰品控： 偏爱高饱和度色彩、追求小众不易撞款且带有独特肌理质感的配饰收集者。 3D 打印精致模型玩家： 喜欢打印薄壁曲面、微缩有机雕塑以及热衷于尝试彩色/丝绸耗材的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保三片花瓣悬空的边缘成型平整、花瓣内部叶脉纹理清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能保证花瓣弯曲处的弧度平滑无台阶感，并完美还原微缩叶脉的细腻质感。 支撑设置（Support）： 建议开启 树状支撑（Tree Support） 。仅在倾斜延伸的花瓣下沿生成少许支撑，确保花瓣悬空部位打印不塌陷且易于拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保纤细的花茎与薄花瓣在佩戴时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚性与更扎实的手感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 25-35 mm/s，确保薄花瓣边缘成型精致不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保佩戴体验顺畅舒适。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指架。 耗材与色彩推荐： 魅惑深紫风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光紫（Matte Purple）或薰衣草紫 PLA 耗材，呈现充满艺术画廊感的高级雕塑质感。 梦幻丝绸/珍珠风： 推荐使用 丝绸紫（Silk Purple）或珍珠白 耗材，光线照射在花瓣的波浪纹理上会产生迷人的光泽折射。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 花瓣尖端在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物。 拆除支撑后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈打磨光滑，使其贴合手指时更加温润亲肤。

description: 盛开玫瑰戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 立体盛开的精雕玫瑰： 戒指正面以一朵层层叠叠、自然包裹绽放的立体玫瑰花头为核心设计，花瓣边缘微卷且层次分明，呈现出极其逼真且高贵优雅的视觉焦点。 双侧浮雕叶脉与花茎戒圈： 戒圈两侧向上延伸出栩栩如生的玫瑰叶片与细小花茎浮雕，叶片上带有清晰呈羽状散开的叶脉纹理，使整枚戒指从正面到侧面都具备连贯的植物美学流动感。 经典一体化戒指结构： 戒圈由下方自然过渡至上方托起整朵盛开的玫瑰，结构完整牢固，兼具华丽的存在感与贴合手指的佩戴体验。 纯白骨瓷/石膏微缩美学： 采用哑光白/石膏白色质感呈现，赋予了作品宛如天然白瓷、石膏微雕或古典象牙雕刻般的雅致浪漫气息。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 节日浪漫与告白赠礼： 玫瑰是爱情与浪漫的经典象征，非常适合作为情人节、求婚、生日或纪念日送给伴侣的仪式感满满的好礼。 法式复古/精致日常穿搭： 作为指尖夸张而优雅的亮眼单品，完美适配法式优雅、小众设计师风、浪漫婚礼或早春约会系穿搭。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于妆台或陈列盘中，优美的玫瑰花姿宛如一座精致的极简植物雕塑。 适配人群 玫瑰与花卉美学爱好者： 偏爱玫瑰花主题、钟情于复古优雅与立体花朵造型的戒指佩戴者。 小众浪漫首饰收集达人： 偏爱白色系、追求高细节雕刻质感且不易撞款的配饰达人。 3D 打印精致模型创客： 喜欢挑战打印多层重叠花瓣、微缩叶脉细节以及热衷于尝试哑光白/陶瓷感耗材的 DIY 玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保玫瑰花瓣层层递进不粘连、侧面叶脉与花茎浮雕细节清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.10mm。较细的层高是确保多层立体花瓣边缘平滑、不出现明显阶梯纹的关键。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在最外层花瓣底部下沿生成少许支撑，注意避免支撑触及内部密集的花瓣缝隙，以便干净拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保花瓣边缘与戒圈在佩戴受力时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚度与扎实的手感分量。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）与顶层建议降速至 20-25 mm/s，慢速打印能保证密集花瓣与叶脉细节精准成型不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 按手指内径等比例缩放： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径。由于花头体积较立体，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保穿脱顺畅，佩戴在食指或中指上效果最佳。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指托盘。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或石膏白 PLA 耗材，呈现现代艺术雕塑般的纯粹干净质感。 梦幻玫瑰粉/复古红： 亦可使用 哑光粉 、 深红 或 丝绸红 耗材，完美还原真实玫瑰的娇艳风采。 古银/做旧风： 推荐使用 丝绸银 耗材打印，完成后用黑色丙烯颜料对花瓣缝隙和叶脉进行“渍洗做旧”，能展现出哥特复古的银饰质感。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 花瓣最外侧边缘在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂蕾丝或丝绸衣物。 拆除支撑后，用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与手指接触面打磨光滑，使其贴合皮肤时更加温润亲肤。

description: 沧璃・龙墟（Azure Glass・Dragon Ruin） 沧璃・龙墟白瓷龙首戒指，以德化羊脂白瓷为创作介质，将东方应龙图腾、古典云纹雕刻与非遗瓷雕工艺融为一体，把龙的磅礴威严凝练成可佩戴的指尖雕塑，打造兼具王者气场、东方底蕴与温润质感的高端艺术首饰。戒体以立体龙首为视觉核心，龙角嶙峋、眉骨劲挺、眼瞳深邃，龙须与獠牙层次分明，呈现神龙昂首回望的威仪姿态；匠人手工逐层雕琢整片龙鳞，每一片鳞甲轮廓饱满、沟壑深浅均匀，排布秩序严谨，细腻肌理经得起近距离品鉴。龙身顺势环抱戒圈，底部与两侧延展为回旋云纹和卷草浮雕，涡旋线条婉转流畅，镂空结构错落交织，承续中式古典云浪纹样，象征云起龙腾、乘风破浪。 整件作品采用 1300℃高温多次入窑烧制，瓷胎致密紧实，硬度优于银、铜等常见金属，耐磨抗磕碰，防水抗汗，日常洗漱无需摘取，长久佩戴依旧保持匀净温润的奶白釉色，不会出现金属氧化发黑、镀层脱落、饰品老化发黄等问题。白瓷釉面呈现柔和内敛的柔光质感，既没有廉价合金的冷硬轻浮，也没有塑料仿制品的死白感，触之细腻顺滑，如羊脂玉石般温润。戒圈内壁做全圆弧精细打磨，贴合指根曲线，适配多种指围；所有龙鳞、云纹凸起棱角全部手工圆角钝化，不会勾挂衣物、划伤肌肤，在霸气外观之下兼顾长时间佩戴的舒适体验。 在中国传统文化中，龙象征祥瑞、权势与前程，缠裹云纹寓意平步青云、生机不息。这枚戒指并非简单复刻龙形符号，而是将东方神话中的雄浑气场压缩于方寸之间，既适合国风穿搭、新中式唐装、改良汉服，也能与黑色西装、皮质风衣、机能潮服形成强烈视觉碰撞。男士佩戴沉稳霸气，自带强者气场；女士佩戴飒爽冷艳，兼具古典神秘与现代先锋感。 市面多数龙形首饰多以合金、银料量产，纹路机械化僵硬，冰冷厚重易磨损，而本款龙首、鳞甲、云纹全部手工雕琢，每一枚鳞片走向、云纹弧度都带有手工独有的细微差异，不存在两枚完全一致的作品，收藏价值远超工业化量产首饰。整件作品摒弃宝石堆砌，完全依托白瓷材质质感与浮雕工艺撑起高级格调，既有东方神兽的雄浑大气，又有白瓷独有的温润雅致。适合追求国风底蕴、偏爱霸气小众风格的佩戴者，日常佩戴彰显审美格局，商务、聚会、晚宴皆能成为视觉焦点，是一枚将神话图腾、瓷雕技艺与现代穿搭美学融于一体的高端白瓷艺术戒指。 Azure Glass · Dragon Ruin white porcelain dragon-head ring is crafted from premium Dehua mutton-fat white porcelain, integrating the oriental Yinglong totem, classical cloud pattern carving and intangible heritage porcelain sculpture craftsmanship. description: The Dovetail Wallet V2 is a compact EDC wallet that holds up to six cards and uses a spring-loaded trigger to fan them out with one press. It also works with fewer than six cards, so you do not need to carry it completely full. I originally started the Dovetail project as a way to better understand how rack-and-pinion gears work. I’m a fifth-grade teacher, and designing useful things is something I do in my free time. The original wallet received a much bigger response than I expected, so I spent a lot of time rebuilding the design and fixing the parts that could be better. What changed in V2 The trigger mechanism has been redesigned to give the cards a more controlled fan instead of launching them out of the wallet. The trigger tension can be adjusted by tightening or loosening the M3 nut on the gear. A nut-free version is also included and can still be adjusted. A retention mechanism at the top of the wallet keeps the cards secure when the trigger is not being pressed. V2 is a complete redesign and is not compatible with parts from the original wallet. Dovetail rail system The wallet includes a dovetail rail system for custom accessories and future attachments. There are not any official attachments available at launch, but I have included an STL of the dovetail connection so other designers can create their own compatible EDC accessories. I plan to continue adding to the system over time. Current Attachements fount in the print profile: Ferro Rod Money Band Included versions The initial release includes: Topographic cover Blank cover (Faceplate Catalog profile) Standard adjustable version Version that does not require an M3 nut I also plan to add more print profiles and customization options. Printing and assembly Assembly Video The wallet is not print-in-place, but the parts are easy to print and assembly is straightforward. The main profile takes approximately 2 hours and 45 minutes to print. It is designed around: 0.4 mm nozzle AMS PLA, PETG, ABS or ASA My preferred material is ASA because it holds up well to regular use and higher temperatures, such as being left inside a vehicle. The wallet in the cover photo was printed with a smooth PEI plate for the front cover. The back was printed on a Bambu carbon-fiber texture plate. Membership Sell at markets or just show some love! Required hardware 2 × M3 × 8 mm machine screws 2 × M3 × 10 mm machine screws 1 × M3 nut (not essential) 1 × 0.4 × 5 × 15 mm compression spring (not essential) Lubricating oil (not essential) The 0.4 × 5 × 15 mm spring is the size I designed and tested the mechanism around. A separate version is included for anyone who wants to print the wallet without using the M3 nut.

Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. description: 蔓藤羽叶植物戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 优雅舒展的羽叶与藤蔓造型： 戒指正面以层次交叠的羽状叶片与弯曲缠绕的柔美藤蔓为核心设计，侧面戒圈融入了复古的蔓藤花纹浮雕，呈现出浓郁的新艺术运动（Art Nouveau）与古典自然美学风格。 精细微雕的叶脉与卷草纹理： 如图中所示，每片叶子上都刻画有极为细腻的平行叶脉纹路，藤蔓节点处带有精致的微型卷草与果实/花蕾造型，配合表面细密的 3D 打印层纹，触感丰富且极具雕塑感。 立体流线型戒圈过渡： 戒圈从后方的光滑平面平滑过渡至前方的多层交叠叶片，既保持了贴合手指的舒适感，又在指背形成立体的视觉焦点。 纯白石膏/骨瓷微缩美学： 采用哑光白/石膏白色质感呈现，赋予了作品宛如天然白瓷、石膏微雕或古典象牙雕刻般的雅致气息。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 法式复古/精致日常穿搭： 作为指尖轻奢优雅的造型亮点，完美适配法式复古、文艺森系、小众设计师风或早春浪漫系穿搭，显得优雅而不失个性。 自然学与古典美学饰品： 蔓藤与叶片象征着生长、生生不息与自然之美，非常适合作为带有温馨寓意的个人幸运指环或纪念礼物。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时立于桌面上（如图中姿态），其独特的立体半包围姿态本身就是一件精美的植物微缩艺术雕塑。 适配人群 植物美学与新艺术风格爱好者： 偏爱自然花草主题、钟情于复古藤蔓线条与优雅立体造型的戒指佩戴者。 小众雕塑感饰品收集者： 偏爱白色系、追求高细节雕刻质感且不易撞款的潮流配饰达人。 3D 打印精致模型创客： 喜欢挑战打印悬空交叠叶片、微缩藤蔓细节以及热衷于尝试哑光白/陶瓷感耗材的 DIY 玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保多层交叠的叶片尖端成型锐利、叶脉与侧面蔓藤浮雕细节清晰不糊化，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.10mm。较细的层高能保证微缩叶脉细节清晰锐利，且使叶片弯曲弧面过渡极其平滑。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在最前方悬空延伸的叶片下沿生成少量支撑，注意避开侧面蔓藤花纹，方便干净拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保纤细的叶片边缘与藤蔓在佩戴受力时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚度与扎实的手感分量。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 20-30 mm/s，确保复杂叶脉与卷草细节精准打印不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 按手指内径等比例缩放： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径。建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保穿脱顺畅舒适，佩戴在食指或中指上视觉效果最佳。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指托架。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白石膏/骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或大理石白 PLA 耗材，呈现现代艺术雕塑般的纯粹高级质感。 做旧古银/复古青铜风： 推荐使用 丝绸银 或 古铜色 耗材。打印完成后，用黑色丙烯颜料对叶脉和藤蔓缝隙进行“渍洗做旧”，能瞬间呈现出博物馆艺术品般的复古立体感！ 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 叶片尖端在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物。 拆除支撑后，用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与手指接触面打磨光滑，使其贴合皮肤时更加温润亲肤。

description: Give your lost item a way back home FoundIt Halo is a customizable lost-and-found tag designed for backpacks, suitcases and bags. Its simple, universal shape makes it suitable for everyday use, while the QR code connects the finder with the owner through the free FoundIt service. Unlike a traditional tag with a phone number or home address printed on it, FoundIt does not expose the owner’s personal details to everyone nearby. It provides a private way to recover lost belongings without publicly displaying the owner’s or finder’s contact information. How FoundIt works Each tag uses its own individual QR code generated on foundit.cc . When someone finds your item, they can scan the QR code and open a contact form connected to your tag. The finder can: send a message to the owner, attach a photo of the found item, share the exact location where the item is located, optionally provide an email address to enable two-way communication. If the finder confirms their email address, both sides can continue the conversation through FoundIt without revealing their email addresses to each other. The finder does not need to create an account or install an app. Create your own tag FoundIt is completely free and allows each account to create up to 20 tags for personal 3D printing. Before printing: Create a free account at foundit.cc/register . Generate a free tag code. Enter the code in the MakerLab Customizer. Check that the generated QR code opens the correct tag page. Generate and print the model. The visible tag number and the QR code must always use the same FoundIt code. Customization options The model can be adjusted directly in the customizer. You can change: the overall tag size, the position of the text, the attachment-hole style, the edge-rounding style, the printing configuration for the detailed face. The simple shape was designed to remain practical and versatile without limiting the tag to one specific type of item. Example file The included example model uses the tag number: PRM-N2E This is an active public demonstration tag connected to FoundIt. You are welcome to scan it and send a test message to see how the service works. For your own printed tag, replace PRM-N2E with a code generated in your FoundIt account. Recommended print settings Material: PETG Nozzle: 0.4 mm Layer height: 0.2 mm Infill: 60% The model was printed and tested on a Bambu Lab P2S. The printed QR code scanned correctly without any problems. Good contrast between the QR code and the base is strongly recommended. Black and white usually provide the most reliable result. Important note FoundIt is not a GPS tracker and does not actively track the location of your item. It cannot prevent theft or guarantee that a lost item will be returned. It provides a simple and private way for an honest finder to contact the owner after finding the tagged item.

description: 极简灵狐手镯（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 首尾呼应的环绕美学： 采用经典的 C 型开口手镯形态，巧妙地将狐狸的头部与蓬松的尾巴分别置于手镯的两端。佩戴时宛如一只灵动的白狐优雅地缠绕在腕间，极具动态美感与自然生机。 极简抽象雕塑质感： 摒弃了繁琐的毛发细节，提取狐狸最迷人的几何轮廓。硬朗的尖耳、修长的吻部与圆润流畅的尾巴形成鲜明对比，整体呈现出类似现代白瓷或骨雕的极简高级感。 灵动的微弹开口设计： 借助 3D 打印材料的物理特性与 C 型结构，手镯天然具备一定的韧性与微弹空间，既保证了佩戴的便捷性，又能很好地贴合不同粗细的手腕。 独特的层纹光影： 表面细腻均匀的 3D 打印层纹非但没有成为瑕疵，反而顺着手镯的弧度生长，形成了一种类似原生木纹或精细手工拉丝的特殊肌理，在侧光下极具艺术气息。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 极简/森系穿搭配饰： 作为日常出街的点睛之笔，完美适配极简风（Normcore）、森系复古风或新中式禅意穿搭，低调却极其吸睛。 精致的桌面首饰陈列： 不佩戴时，可将其挂在首饰架上，或直接立于桌面，本身就是一件极具欣赏价值的微缩动物雕塑。 独特的心意伴手礼： 狐狸常被赋予“灵智”与“守护”的寓意，作为礼物送给闺蜜或伴侣，既别致又充满浪漫色彩。 适配人群 小众设计首饰控： 厌倦了市面上千篇一律的金属手镯，追求有温度、有故事感、极简设计语言的饰品爱好者。 自然与动物爱好者： 对狐狸等灵性动物元素情有独钟的文艺青年。 3D 打印实用派： 喜欢将 3D 打印技术应用于日常生活穿搭，享受“所想即所得、随时定制尺寸”乐趣的创客玩家。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保手镯具备足够的结构强度（防止佩戴时断裂），同时完美展现狐狸五官的锐利感，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐使用 0.12mm - 0.16mm。较低的层高能够让狐狸尾巴的圆弧过渡更加顺滑，同时确保狐狸鼻尖和眼睛部位的细节不丢失。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 强烈建议设置为 4 - 5 层。对于手镯类受力模型，增加外墙厚度是提升整体抗折断韧性的最有效方法。 填充率（Infill）： 必须设置为 100%（实心打印）。开口手镯在穿脱时会产生向外撑开的应力，实心打印能赋予其最大的结构刚性与安全性。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s，慢速打印能让狐狸头部的悬空面（如下巴处）成型更加完美，减少打磨工作量。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与测量参考： 定制缩放： 打印前，请务必使用软尺或游标卡尺测量佩戴者手腕侧面（最窄处）的宽度。在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使手镯开口的距离略小于手腕最窄宽度，手镯内径的宽度略大于手腕正面宽度即可。 耗材推荐（核心关键）： 材质选择： 由于手镯需要被微微撑开才能佩戴， 极其不建议使用普通脆性 PLA （很容易在戴上的瞬间“啪”地断裂）。强烈建议使用 PETG 、 ABS 或 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 耗材，它们具有绝佳的弹性恢复力，能承受日常的穿脱形变。 色彩美学： 推荐 哑光白（Matte White） 、象牙白（Ivory） 展现骨雕质感；或者使用 仿木耗材（Wood PLA）打印后轻轻打磨，呈现出极其逼真的手工木雕手镯效果。 佩戴小贴士： 正确的佩戴方式是将手腕侧过来（手腕最窄的方向），将手镯开口对准手腕侧面滑入，然后再旋转至手腕正面，这样可以最大限度减少对手镯的强行拉扯。 边缘打磨： 打印完成后，建议使用 800 目 - 1000 目的细砂纸，将手镯内圈与皮肤接触的边缘进行轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时极致亲肤、不刮手。

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 般若赤曜・鬼面戒（Hannya Crimson Radiance Ring） 般若赤曜红雕鬼面戒指，甄选高密天然朱砂原料打造，融合日式般若鬼面图腾与中式缠枝卷草浮雕工艺，将东方鬼神美学、手工雕刻艺术浓缩于戒面方寸，打造野性张扬、底蕴厚重的国风暗黑系高端配饰。整枚戒指以经典般若鬼头为主体，双角挺拔凌厉，眉眼紧绷怒蹙，獠牙外露、齿列分明，自带威慑气场；匠人通体手工深雕，面部、犄角、戒身遍布连绵回旋的缠枝纹样，藤蔓纹路蜿蜒交错，深浅沟壑错落有致，每一处卷曲弧度都经过手工反复打磨，浮雕层次立体饱满，强光之下纹路明暗错落，雕刻细节分毫毕现。 朱砂自古以来被视作祥瑞护身之物，传统文化中主镇煞安身、辟邪纳福，赤红正色热烈浓烈，象征红火顺遂、气场强盛。原料经过多道打磨固化，质地紧实坚硬，不易磕碰磨损，抗汗耐潮，日常佩戴不怕沾水氧化，长期佩戴依旧色泽鲜亮饱满，不会发白褪色。戒圈内壁做圆润弧面全抛光处理，边缘顺滑无毛刺，长时间佩戴贴合指腹，不会磨手卡肤；戒身所有雕花凸起位置全部做柔化倒角，杜绝勾扯衣物，兼顾夸张艺术造型与日常佩戴舒适度。 这款戒指打破传统珠宝柔美路线，以刚猛诡谲的般若美学塑造独特辨识度。男士搭配机车皮衣、工装、新中式禅酷穿搭、暗黑西装，气场冷冽霸气，自带不羁气场；女士适配亚文化穿搭、汉服改良款、酷飒风衣，柔媚与野性对冲，氛围感极强。市面上同类鬼面首饰多为合金电镀，易掉色变形，雕刻纹路死板流水线化；本款全程手工雕镂，每一枚藤蔓走向、面部肌理都具备独一无二的手工痕迹，收藏属性拉满。 赤红朱砂撞上古诡般若，既有民俗朱砂的祈福寓意，又有面具美学的先锋个性。不管是日常穿搭彰显小众审美，潮玩聚会打造吸睛造型，还是作为特色文玩藏品收藏都十分合适。它跳出常规首饰的设计套路，把民俗信仰、传统雕刻、潮流穿搭三者合一，是兼具佩戴价值、文化寓意与手工收藏价值的小众高端指环，适合偏爱暗黑国风、个性潮酷、喜欢民俗文玩风格的佩戴者。 Hannya Crimson Radiance Ring is elaborately crafted with high-density natural cinnabar, combining traditional Japanese Hannya mask totem and Chinese interlocking scroll relief carving techniques. It condenses oriental ghost aesthetics and hand-carving craftsmanship into a wearable ring, forming a high-end dark-style accessory with wild temperament and profound cultural heritage. Centered on classic Hannya demon face, the ring features sharp upward horns, furrowed angry brows, exposed fangs and clear teeth layout, delivering an imposing deterrent vibe. Every detail including facial texture, horns and band surface is covered with winding scroll patterns hand-carved in deep relief. Twisting vines interlace intricately with varied carving depth. The layered textures produce distinct light and shadow under illumination, presenting fully visible delicate carving details. Cinnabar has long been recognized as an auspicious material in traditional culture, believed to ward off negative energy and bring peace and good fortune. Its vivid scarlet shade stands for prosperity, passion and powerful personal aura. Processed with compaction and polishing, the cinnabar body is hard and sturdy, resistant to abrasion, sweat and moisture. It maintains bright permanent color without fading or whitening even with long-term daily wear and frequent water contact. The inner band is finely polished into smooth rounded curves with no rough edges, fitting fingers comfortably without chafing skin. All raised carving edges are softly chamfered to prevent snags on clothing, balancing dramatic artistic appearance with wearable practicality. Breaking the gentle aesthetic of mainstream jewelry, this ring adopts fierce, mysterious Hannya design for exclusive recognition. For men, it pairs flawlessly with motorcycle leather jackets, workwear, dark neo-Chinese outfits and edgy suits, creating cold, powerful and unrestrained charm. For women, it matches alternative fashion, modified Hanfu and sharp trench coats, forming striking contrast between femininity and wildness. Most mass-produced Hannya jewelry uses electroplated alloy prone to fading and deformation with rigid machine carving lines. This ring is entirely hand-sculpted, with exclusive irregular details on vines and facial textures on every single piece, endowing outstanding collectible value. Scarlet cinnabar paired with antique Hannya perfectly combines folk blessing symbolism and avant-garde mask art. It serves well for daily styling to highlight niche taste, for parties to stand out visually, and for cultural curation as collectible art. Transcending conventional jewelry design, it integrates folk culture, traditional carving and modern street fashion. It is a premium niche ring with wearable functionality, cultural connotation and handmade collectibility, ideal for wearers fond of dark oriental style, edgy streetwear and folk vintage accessories.

description: 双环灵蛇手镯与戒指两用款（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 首饰两用形变结构： 突破传统单一饰品的界限，采用模块化/可拉伸（或比例自由缩放）的双环架构，既能作为精巧立体的指尖戒指，也可放大作为手腕上的潮流手镯，兼具实用性与创意玩法。 灵动缠绕的双环形态： 采用蛇身交叉缠绕交错构成的“数字8”或双环结构，线条曲折优雅，宛如一条灵蛇在手腕或指尖盘旋上升。 逼真细腻的鳞片肌理： 如图中所示，蛇身表面雕刻有极其细腻的蛇鳞纹理，与蛇头精致的眼睛及头部轮廓相呼应，赋予模型强烈的野性美感与雕塑质感。 高辨识度的黄/金配色视觉： 采用了明亮亮眼的黄色（或金色）视觉呈现，既带有神秘的图腾色彩，又极具现代潮流个性的撞色效果。 立体动态与结构美学： 蛇头自然悬浮于戒圈/镯圈上方呈吐信观望姿态，整体立体感极强，从各个视角观赏都有不同的空间延伸感。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 多场景自由切换穿搭： 根据今日造型需求自由选择作为“手镯”还是“戒指”佩戴，完美适配暗黑风、街头潮流、雅痞风或美式复古穿搭，瞬间提升整体造型感。 神秘学与图腾爱好者集合： 蛇象征着重生、智慧与无限（莫比乌斯），非常适合作为具备特殊符号意味的个人幸运饰品。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时立于桌面上，其独特的自立式双环几何形态本身就是一座小巧精致的蛇形艺术雕像。 适配人群 百变饰品与多功能首饰控： 喜欢一件多用、打破常规饰品形态，追求夸张立体感、曲线美感与高辨识度饰品的收集者。 生肖属蛇/神秘学元素爱好者： 偏爱蛇类、图腾生物、带有神秘主义色彩配饰的潮流人群。 3D 打印模型玩家： 喜欢打印高难度悬空曲面、挑战复杂有机生物结构与鳞片细节的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保蛇身缠绕的悬空部位不塌陷、蛇鳞与蛇头细节清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能保证蛇身弯曲处的曲面过渡光滑，并完美还原微缩蛇鳞的颗粒感。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在蛇头悬空处及蛇身底部交叉处生成少量支撑，既易于拆除又能避免损坏表面鳞片。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。较厚的外墙能确保纤细的蛇身在作为手镯或戒指佩戴受力时，具备足够的韧性与抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚性与扎实的手感分量。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 25-35 mm/s，确保蛇鳞细节清晰不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与两用佩戴参考： 戒指形态佩戴（内径 16mm - 20mm）： 在切片软件中按手指内径等比例缩放。由于此款为交叉双环结构，佩戴时包裹感较强，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.5mm - 0.8mm。 手镯形态佩戴（内径 55mm - 65mm）： 在切片软件中放大至手腕周长对应内径即可打印成手镯款。 柔性两用打印方案： 强烈建议尝试使用 TPU（柔性耗材） 打印中间尺寸，利用 TPU 材料的延展韧性，使其既能伸缩套在手腕上当手镯，也能弯折或多圈盘绕当戒指使用！ 耗材与色彩推荐： 鲜艳潮流风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光黄（Matte Yellow）或明黄 PLA/TPU 耗材，呈现充满现代街头感的艺术雕塑效果。 奢华黄金/黑金风： 推荐使用 丝绸金（Silk Gold）或枪黑色 耗材。若使用黑色耗材，打印后可用金/银色丙烯颜料对蛇鳞进行干刷（Dry Brush），能瞬间爆发出极具逼真感的金属做旧鳞片效果。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 蛇头及蛇尾尖端在打印成型后可能较为锐利，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止作为手镯或戒指佩戴时刮伤衣物。 拆除支撑后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将内圈与皮肤接触部位打磨光滑，使其贴合手腕与手指时更加温润亲肤。

description: Smart NFC Medical ID Keychain / Emergency Tag This is a functional, dual-sided medical alert keychain designed to store critical health information using an embedded NFC chip. It features the universally recognized Star of Life on one side and a Tap Here / Scan prompt on the other, making it immediately clear to paramedics, doctors, or bystanders that vital medical data is inside. Perfect for individuals with chronic conditions (such as diabetes, epilepsy, severe allergies, or heart conditions) and seniors. 🛠️ Print & Assembly Instructions: NFC Chip Embedded In-Print: This model features an internal pocket designed for a coin-style NFC sticker/disc (Optimized for NTAG216, 25mm diameter) . The Pause Trick: To insert the chip, insert a Pause command (Color Change or Pause at height) in your slicer right before the printer covers the internal pocket (around 0.6mm - 0.8mm above the pocket floor). Pop the NFC tag in, and resume printing. Dual-Color Setup: Print the base in one color (e.g., White) and change the filament to a contrasting color (e.g., Red or Black) for the text and icons to ensure high readability. Slicer Tip: If the fine details of the Rod of Asclepius (the snake) or hand icon don't appear in your slicer preview, enable the Arachne wall generator or Detect Thin Walls . 📱 How to Program: Use any free app like NFC Tools to write your data. With an NTAG216 chip, you have plenty of memory (888 bytes) to write text records with your Name, Emergency Contacts (ICE), Diagnoses, and Blood Type. Don't forget to Lock the tag after writing so nobody can erase your data!

Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 跳舞骨架鱼缸打氧摆件｜免支撑优化款 关于打印问题的一些解答： 1.测试使用的耗材为白色PLA Basic,我看了评论区有很多朋友肋骨或者脚骨处打印出现了偏移，这通常是散热不足导致的层间粘合问题，打印本模型建议全程打开仓门散热，如果仓外温度＞37℃的地区，建议外墙速度降至80mm/s以下。 2.关于骨骼不跳舞的原因：原因a：检查中轴固定的耗材丝是否平直，扭曲会造成卡顿；原因b：出气的速率要控制在3.5L/min左右，在刚开始的过程中可以手动倾斜一个角度让它形成稳定的气泡后放开手；原因C：请保证底座处于水平状态，倾斜会持续造成模型卡在某一节点；原因D:有少部分模型可能存在版本问题，建议检查一下骨骼站立的盖子是否属于最新的版本。 7.27 1时 修正了固定槽公差太紧和脚固定位置偏外的问题，如果脚还是太宽，可以自己调一下卡槽两个预留方块的间隙。 7.26 10时 添加了骨架和底座固定槽及优化了打印参数 7.25 16时 修正了一些参数及模型问题 🐟 一口气泵，骨架就跳起来了。 装在鱼缸里的"打氧跳舞摆件"：气泵的气泡/气流从气管进入主体，顶动内部斜放的 挡板 ，让盒体来回轻摆——站在上面的可动小骨架就跟着"跳舞"。好玩、解压，还能给水面添点动静。 ✨ 本版亮点：底部吸盘 + 全程免支撑 吸盘在底部 ：安装柱竖直朝下，贴缸底/缸壁更稳，不易被水流冲歪。 打印无需支撑 ：吸盘柱竖向、悬垂面已优化，可 关掉支撑 直接打——省料、省时、表面干净、没拆支撑的疤，新手友好。 已实测 ：已打印并通气测试，骨架摆动正常、吸盘固定牢靠。 吸盘尺寸： 🧩 兼容与玩法 顶部兼容 任意关节可动骨架/小人 ，自行用胶水定 pose。 主体与挡板分件打印； 中间固定孔穿一段打印耗材丝 ，两端烫平/压扁当销（兼作铰链），把挡板连成可摆结构。 🔧 装配 4 步 1.打印主体（含底部吸盘柱）与挡板。 2.取一小段耗材丝穿过 中间固定孔 ，两端用烙铁/打火机烫平（或剪断卡紧）当销/铰链；确认挡板能自由摆动。 3.骨架站上去，胶水固定关节。 4.底部装入蘑菇头吸盘/石头固定支架 → 吸到缸底/缸壁 → 接气管 → 开气泵，开跳 💃 📐 适配吸盘规格（配件实测值，已填好） 型号：2.5 cm 蘑菇 平头 吸盘 吸盘面外径：25 mm 蘑菇头（平帽）直径：7.5 mm 卡颈高度：2 mm 卡颈直径：4 mm 匹配打印孔（建议， 请按你模型实际孔确认 ）：通孔 ≈ 4.0–4.2 mm 卡住 4 mm 颈；该处板厚 ≈ 2 mm 贴合颈高夹紧；帽侧留 ≥ 8 mm 沉孔/让位，让 7.5 mm 平头贴平。 气管内径：约【4.7 mm】（如你的孔不同请改） 🖨️ 打印建议（实测配方 · 重点：不用支撑） 层高 0.12 mm （实测配方；赶时间可 0.16 / 0.2 草稿） 壁厚 2–3 圈 ｜ 填充 15–20% 支撑：关闭 ✅ 摆放：吸盘柱 朝下贴板 ；挡板单独平放 底板附着： Brim 5 mm （实测推荐，保住吸盘柱细脚的首层附着） 接缝：背面或随机 耗材：浸水/有加热灯的缸建议 PETG ；PLA 仅短期展示，泡水+升温易软化变形。能控翘边也可 ASA/ABS。 🏷️ 标签 ：鱼缸 鱼缸装饰 打氧 增氧 气泵 跳舞 骨架 骷髅 摆件 免支撑 无需支撑 吸盘 万圣节 解压 ｜ aquarium, fish tank, ornament, aerator, air pump, dancing, skeleton, skull, support-free, no support, suction cup, fidget, Halloween

Parametric Electronics Panel Generator Create fully customized front panels for electronics projects directly in MakerWorld’s Parametric Model Maker. This generator combines a configurable base plate, component-specific cutout presets, fan openings, mounting holes and optional labels in one single OpenSCAD file. It is designed for control panels, power supplies, workshop equipment, enclosures, test stations, model-making projects and other custom electronics applications. Customizable panel The base panel can be adjusted to fit the required enclosure or installation area. Available panel settings include: panel width and height panel thickness rounded corners upper edge chamfer optional raised border four optional mounting holes optional countersinks manual or automatic cutout arrangement The model is centered around the origin and has a completely flat underside for easy printing. Up to 10 configurable cutouts The panel supports up to ten independently configurable component positions. Each cutout can be: enabled or disabled positioned individually rotated freely arranged automatically in a grid combined with mounting holes combined with anti-rotation holes combined with side locking reliefs labeled separately Selecting None disables the corresponding cutout. Included cutout types The generator includes basic geometric openings as well as presets for common electronic components. Available types include: round hole slot rectangle rounded rectangle USB-A USB-C RJ45 toggle switch rocker switch potentiometer rotary encoder display standard fan sizes custom fan XT60 (V2 only) The component presets use different starting geometries and optional secondary openings. Manual dimensions can still be used when a specific component differs from the preset. Because component dimensions vary between manufacturers, the actual part should always be measured before printing the final panel. Fan cutouts and ventilation grills Fan cutouts include the central airflow area and the corresponding mounting-hole pattern. Available fan options include several standard sizes and a fully customizable fan type. Different ventilation styles can be selected: open circle cross radial slots honeycomb concentric rings The grill rotation, bar width, opening size and mounting-hole dimensions can be adjusted. Individual component labels Every cutout can receive its own text label. For each label, the following can be configured: label text engraved or raised style position above, below, left or right text size text depth or height distance from the component additional X and Y offset independent text rotation The label is positioned relative to the associated component and moves together with it when the cutout is repositioned. Typical labels include: POWER USB NETWORK DISPLAY FAN INPUT OUTPUT RESET VOLUME ON / OFF All component labels can also be disabled globally. Optional panel title A separate title can be added to the complete panel. The title can be placed at the top or bottom and can be either engraved or raised. Possible applications include: CONTROL PANEL POWER SUPPLY FAN CONTROLLER TEST STATION WORKSHOP CONTROL BATTERY MONITOR The title size, depth, edge distance, position and rotation can be adjusted independently. Automatic layout When automatic layout is enabled, all active cutouts are placed in a configurable grid. The user can define: number of columns horizontal spacing vertical spacing complete layout offset Individual cutout dimensions and rotations remain active, while their manual position values are ignored. Typical applications The generator is suitable for: electronics enclosures control panels bench power supplies workshop machines fan controllers test equipment Raspberry Pi and microcontroller projects audio equipment vehicle and camper installations robotics and model making custom switch and connector panels Printing The panel is designed to print with its flat rear side directly on the build plate. In this orientation: the chamfer faces upward countersinks face upward engraved labels remain visible raised labels are printed on top supports are normally not required For mechanically loaded panels, use a suitable material and sufficient wall thickness. Important note The included presets are intended as practical starting points. USB modules, RJ45 sockets, switches, displays and other components are not fully standardized between manufacturers. Always measure the actual component and verify: main opening dimensions mounting-hole spacing locking tabs panel thickness requirements required printing tolerance V2 includes XT60! Introduction I present to you the Cinema Rig in my two part LunaRig series (The other being the LunaRig Compact ). These rigs are built around Instra360's Luna Ultra camera. This rig is meant to get a little more serious with the film work, offering protection, a more solid feel, tons of mounting spots, configuration options, an external mount for a battery, and two lens hoods for wide or regular. The side grips can be mounted in a variety of configurations to suit your needs. The top handle includes a mounting point for the remote control, to get it up and a little more into view, while your camera is mounted in the rig. The lens hoods are meant to provide protection, but also a mounting point for a matte box. The wide version is 110mm on the OD and the regular one is 95mm OD. Because of the lens configuration on the Luna, when you take a hard left turn, the lens hood will come into view while at 1x zoom. Works best when zoomed in to at least 2x, although the wide lens hood will accommodate the 1x better, provided you don't turn too quickly. This rig is intended to be used in Roll Lock or FPV gimbal modes. The back bracket provides a ¼" mounting spot for an NP-F style battery plate. description: YL RC Water Cannon | CyberBrick Powered Remote-Controlled Water Turret Introduction Hello everyone! This is my first CyberBrick-powered project — YL RC Water Cannon . The entire model is built specifically for the Bambu Lab CyberBrick platform . All water tubing, wiring and mounting screws are completely hidden inside the structure, creating a clean and integrated appearance. Extensive optimization and repeated print testing have also been carried out to ensure reliable printing, straightforward assembly and enjoyable operation. This dual-bearing design significantly improves rigidity, rotational stability and overall operating smoothness. Optimized for 3D Printing This model has been carefully optimized for FDM 3D printing. Since dimensional tolerances vary between different printers and materials, every critical assembly has gone through multiple rounds of redesign, printing and testing to improve assembly success and printing reliability. My goal is to make the building experience as smooth as possible for everyone. Design Process This project has gone through multiple design iterations. Starting from a simple functional prototype, it gradually evolved into the current version with: hidden wiring and tubing concealed mounting screws mechanical recoil mechanism elevation limit protection structural optimization improved appearance Many components were redesigned and reprinted several times throughout development. Featured in this Tom's Hardware article . 2.5" SSD Dock + Cartridge System This Collection includes model files for: Inner / Outer Case for the SSD Cartridge (with cutouts for printed artworks) BigDock: Sturdy dock with ball bearings to guide the cartridges in from the front SmallDock: Small, low-profile, simple dock. Cartridge insertion from the top. Blank front plates for both dock versions for your own customization. These docks have been designed with 1 specific USB-to-SATA Adapter in mind: Sabrent (EC-SSHD) Disclaimer SATA data and power connectors are typically rated for 50 to 500 insertion cycles (mating cycles) before pin degradation. Always insert carefully without needing much force. Assembly Notes Cartridges: Because of manufacturing tolerances for SSDs, you might have to put some thin tape on the SSDs before inserting them into the Case. Just make it tight enough of a fit so that the SSDs wont slide out of the case when unplugging from the Dock. The Handle has through holes for screwing in the M3x6 screws to secure the outer case to the inner case. I recommend gluing or double-sided tape the “top end” of the outer casing to the inner casing. Big Dock: Put the Dock into the base first, then slide the Adapter in, and only then screw the adapter cover on. If you put the adapter in the dock first, you won't be able to put the dock into the base. The optional slide guard needs to be glued on or stuck on with thin double-sided tape. The FrontPlate can also be glued on or stuck on with thin double-sided tape. The Bearing Pins is just friction fit to allow easier removal of bearings. They slide in from the bottom. The Dock itself should fit nicely into the base. If it's too lose, feel free to glue down or use double-sided tape. There are 2x M3 holes on the bottom of the dock, in case you want to bolt it down into something. Small Dock: The FrontPlate can also be glued on or stuck on with thin double-sided tape. The Sabrent Adapter only goes in one way. Be mindful when inserting the adapter. Customization Provided are 2 blank front plates (.stp) that you can customize. The Cutouts for printed artworks are of dimensions: 90 x 60 mm (1.5 : 1) Steam Auto-start Scripts For those of you who are interested into making these as your game cartridges. description: SIMPLE . FLYING . FUN Hummel RC is a simple and fun two-channel RC airplane designed for relaxed flights on a small field. Its modular construction is lightweight, durable and quick to print, with low material use and smooth, stable flight behavior. The adjustable wing position makes CG and pitch tuning easy. The model has no movable control surfaces: altitude is controlled by total motor thrust, while turns are performed through differential thrust between the two wing-mounted motors. Hummel RC continues the ideas of WingStar , COMET , Wespe , SkyStar and DragonFly in a compact and practical RC model made to fly often . 1 - Model Data Wingspan: 405 mm Length: 365 mm Wing chord: 60 mm Model mass (with RC receiver, battery and motors): 43 g. 2 - Equipment RC transmitter and receiver: 2 Channel 2.4G FX803 J3 ( Aliexpress link here ) Battery: 3.7v, 220 mAh, Molex 51005 connector ( Aliexpress link here ) Motors and Props: 2x716 Coreless motors with 2 props diam 46 mm ( Aliexpress link here ) 3 - Materials, Settings, Printing Model design created and tested using Bambu PLA Basi c. Use this material for best results. Do NOT use PLA Matte, especially for the wing parts. Printed parts may deform after removal from the Plate due to internal material strains after cooling. Use recommended print settings. Note: The print profile for A1 mini use slightly higher material flow coefficient (1.03 instead of 0.98). For reliable printing: Clean the printing Plate before printing. After printing, remove the Plate and let it cool for 3-4 minutes Do not remove parts while the Plate is hot. 4 - Model Assembly The model consists of 20 parts, as shown in the figure. 1 – Nose, 2 – PCB Mount, 3 – A-Beam (3pcs), 4 – B-Beam, 5 – Strut (2pcs), 6 – Sting, 7 – Tail, 8 – Fin, 9 – Central Bracket, 10 – Dual-pin, 11 – Right Wing, 12 – Left Wing , 13 – Right Big Rib, 14 – Left Big Rib, 15 – Small Rib (2pcs), 16 – Gear mount, 17 – Gear Strut (2pcs), 18 – Wheel (2pcs), 19 – Pin (2pcs), 20 – BHCS Screw M2 x 4 mm (4 pcs). Note : RC Receiver, Engines, props are not shown. The following assembly steps are shown without the electronic components installed. It is recommended to review them before installing the motors and electronics. Use cyanoacrylate glue where specifically indicated. Assemble the tail unit and fuselage as shown. Assemble the wing as shown in the figure. Use Dual-pin to fix wings. After installing and fixing the wing surfaces, install Big Ribs (13, 14) on both sides. Finally, install the Ribs (15) on both sides. Wing assembly completed. To install the wing on the fuselage, pull the fuselage beam through predefined guide points on the wing Central Bracket, as shown in the picture. A slight pushing force may be gently applied if needed. Assemble landing gear unit as shown on Figure. Install landing gear on Fuselage. To fix finally the wing and landing gear position the M2x4 screws to be installed. Do not fix wing and gear assembly finally on this step! 4.1 - Electronic Components Installation Install RC transmitter PCB on bracket (2). Finally, connect the motors to the receiver board as shown in the illustration. Before final assembly, make sure the motors rotate in opposite directions. For easier assembly and adjustment, the wires should be approximately 130 mm long. The wires are preferable to route through the rib. To install the motor in the rib, gently press it into place and slide it slightly forward until there is no gap. To prevent the motor from rotating during operation, secure it with a small piece of adhesive tape, as shown in the illustration. Install the ribs with the motors onto the wing as shown in the illustration. The motors must be positioned on the outer side of each rib. Install the wing onto the lower beam, approximately at the middle of the span. Then route the motor wires behind the lower beam and around the upper beam in a figure-eight pattern, as shown in the illustration. This routing keeps the wires secure while still allowing the wing position to be adjusted. Only after routing the wires, install the landing gear, followed by the receiver bracket (2). Install the nose part (1) and secure it with screw (20). Install the battery and hold it in place with a suitable rubber band, as shown on picture. The model assembly is now complete. 4.2 - Balancing Perform the pre-flight balancing check with the battery installed. Place the model on a Balancing Stand ( model link here ) using the designated balance points on the wing. The model should remain level or tip slightly nose-down. Fix finally the screws (20) of wing assembly and gear bracket. 5 - Model Flight Launch the model outdoors in calm weather or slight breeze conditions. Recommended wind speed: up to 5 km/h (≈1.4 m/s, ≈2.7 knots) . Always launch the model directly into the wind . Model initially pre-balanced during assembly. Launch the model applying full throttle with a gentle horizontal push. If the model dives strongly, then: Move the wing slightly forward, OR bend the elevator slightly upward. If the model pitches up or stalls, first try reducing the flight speed. If flight speed reduction does not help, then: Move the wing slightly backward, OR bend the elevator slightly downward. Happy Flights and Smooth Landings!

model_name: LoopLoom - fully 3D printable tablet weaving loom
description: LoopLoom - a fully 3D printable tablet weaving loom. The goal: Long warps. Small footprint. No tools. There's no question about it: A nice wooden loom is fun to use and looks great. But it also takes up quite a bit of space, isn't exactly light, and isn't cheap either. For beginners or when you're on the go: A printable loom would be just the thing! The facts: 2,5 meter (100 inch) warp. Adjustable waving angle. Printable on 256mm bed size. The three adjustable extensions allow you to stretch up to 2.5 meters of ribbon—realistically, you can weave braids about 2 meters long. Using the two front extensions, you can adjust the angle to be steeper or flatter: You can adjust the thread tension on all three extensions. On the left side of each extension, there is a screw that you can use to loosen or tighten it. To secure the thread at the beginning, simply tie a knot in the cord and pull it through the slot from the right: If you're used to doing it this way with another frame (e.g., an "Ashford inkle loom"), you can also screw a 3mm screw into the existing hole and wrap the thread around it. When you want to store the LoopLoom, you can loosen the screw that secures the base and pull the base out. It then snaps into place—with a click—in the center of the frame, making the LoopLoom even more portable: That's exactly how the frame with the foot comes out of your printer. Apply a little pressure to the foot to remove it, slide it onto the frame from the back (there's a slot in the frame for this), and secure it with the screw that matches the frame's color: The print: 2 plates, 2 colors. Since the frame is very large, it tends to warp during printing. I’ve therefore made a few optimizations, which you can read about here . In my enclosed printers (P1S and X1C), this allows me to print the frame perfectly flat—which is important for the extensions to work properly. Either use my print profile or slice it yourself: Start with a 0.16 mm profile as a base, set the infill to 10% gyroid, and adjust the number of walls for the different parts: Cover caps: 2 Screws, base: 3 Frame: 4 Slide-outs: 5 Slide-out 3—the longest one—should be as sturdy as possible: 7 walls and 50% infill. Although I usually print with engineering filaments, plain PLA is the best choice here because stiffness is key. If you have PLA-CF, you can use it for the extensions (i.e., for Plate 2), but it’s not necessary. Here, I printed the first plate in “PLA matte dark brown” and the second in “PLA matte dark chocolate brown”: Some of the pieces on Plate 2 have changed since the photo was taken, and a shuttle has been added: If you prefer weaving shuttles that are a little bigger and fit better in your hand, here’s another model I made. If you'd prefer the foot to be a little heavier or thicker (for example, so you can wedge it between your legs on the sofa more easily), just place the foot on a suitable wooden board. Trace around it and cut it out. Screw the foot onto the board—there are already 4 holes for countersunk screws. I'll take some photos of this soon. I hope you have a lot of fun weaving—if so, I'd love to see a photo of the border, but I'd also appreciate a like, a good review, or a boost! And of course, feel free to ask questions if things aren't working out as they should. If you'd like to sell the loom, please contact me. Update 19.07.2026 I made a slight modification to slide 3; it now has a height-adjustable foot. This prevents the loom from wobbling when the slide bends upward slightly due to thread tension. You can easily reprint and replace the slide.
